summary: Where form meets feeling — the Happy Hour series by Hatria Ceramica brings Italian artistry into the rhythm of everyday life. Compact in size yet bold in character, each basin blends sculptural elegance with pure functionality.
title: The New Happy Hour Series
bodyHtml:
A Playful New Expression

Design and personality for every hour — the new Happy Hour series from Hatria Ceramica brings expressive form and everyday functionality to life.

Compact in size yet rich in presence, each Italian-made basin embodies the balance between sculptural design and practical usability.


Happy Hour Oval 57 Undercounter - 570 x 380 x 150 mm

Design Freedom, Thoughtfully Delivered

From bold, bench-mounted centrepieces to discreet undercounter models, Happy Hour offers a basin for every mood and every space.

Select versions also include tap decks for added functionality, making them ideal for compact bathrooms or where spatial efficiency is key.

(original product details unavailable)


Happy Hour 75X in Matte Sand - 750 x 380 x 150 mm

Italian Craftsmanship, Timeless Colours

Crafted in Italy by Hatria, our newest manufacturing partner, the Happy Hour series celebrates considered design and enduring craftsmanship.

A contemporary yet timeless colour palette makes it effortless to pair with any material scheme — from natural stone to terrazzo and timber.
